welcome.title: LazyCalAI
welcome.subtitle: Track your calories with AI-powered food recognition. Just take a photo of your meal and let AI do the rest.
welcome.apiKeyNotice: To recognize dishes, the app will require an API key for an AI provider. Several of them are free: some OpenRouter models need no credit card, Gemini has a free tier, and OpenAI gives a limited number of free tokens if you share your data. Only 5 recognitions are available in demo mode.

result.bmiAgeNote: BMI categories apply to adults. For ages 5-19, WHO uses age- and sex-specific growth charts.

guide.title: Get your {{provider}} API key
guide.intro: Follow these steps to create an API key, then copy it back into the app.
guide.openai:
1. Go to platform.openai.com and sign in (or create an account).
2. Open the “API keys” page from the left sidebar.
3. Click “Create new secret key”, name it, and confirm.
4. Copy the key (it starts with sk-) right away — you won't be able to see it again.
5. Using the API requires billing credit on your OpenAI account.
**6. You can also get a limited amount of free tokens per day by sharing your data with OpenAI. Enable it in Profile Settings → Data Controls → Sharing → “Share inputs and outputs with OpenAI”.
guide.claude:
1. Go to console.anthropic.com and sign in (or create an account).
2. Open “API Keys” in your account settings.
3. Click “Create Key”, name it, and confirm.
4. Copy the key and paste it back into the app.
5. You'll need billing credit on your Anthropic account to make requests.
guide.gemini:
1. Go to aistudio.google.com and sign in with your Google account.
2. Click “Get API key” in the top-left menu.
3. Click “Create API key” and pick a Google Cloud project.
4. Copy the generated key and paste it back into the app.
**5. The free tier is generous, so you can usually start without billing.
guide.gemini_free:
1. Go to aistudio.google.com and sign in with your Google account.
2. Click “Get API key” in the top-left menu.
3. Click “Create API key” and pick a Google Cloud project with no billing account linked.
4. Copy the generated key and paste it back into the app.
**5. Do NOT turn on billing for that project. The app works only with Free Tier keys: the key is checked before every analysis and a key with billing enabled is rejected.
guide.grok:
1. Go to console.x.ai and sign in with your X account.
2. Open the “API Keys” section.
3. Click “Create API Key”, name it, and confirm.
4. Copy the key and paste it back into the app.
5. xAI requires prepaid credits before the API will work.
guide.qwen:
1. Go to bailian.console.aliyun.com (Alibaba Cloud Model Studio) and sign in.
2. Open “API-KEY” management from the account menu.
3. Click “Create API Key” and confirm.
4. Copy the key and paste it back into the app.
5. Make sure the Qwen (Tongyi) models are enabled for your account.
guide.openrouter:
1. Go to openrouter.ai and sign in (or create an account).
2. Open “Keys” from your account menu.
3. Click “Create Key”, name it, and confirm.
4. Copy the key and paste it back into the app.
5. Add credits to your OpenRouter account to use paid models.
**5.1. You don't need a credit card to use free models - you can skip this step.

apiKey.freeTierBody: To recognize images using AI, you need to enter the Free Google Gemini API key. The app works ONLY with keys created in Free Tier. Create one in Google AI Studio without turning on billing, then paste it below.
apiKey.freeTierPaidBlocked: A key with billing enabled will NOT work. The key is checked before every analysis and a paid key is rejected.
apiKey.freeTierHint: Your key is checked before every analysis. If billing is ever enabled on it, photo analysis stops working.
apiKey.noKeyNotice: Without a key you can still add meals by hand, but photo analysis will not work.
apiKey.skipMessage: Photo analysis needs a free Gemini key. Without one, only manual meal entry will work. You can add a key later in Settings.

home.title: LazyCalAI
home.noMeals: No meals logged today. Tap + to add one.

freeUse.title: Free, with no payments
freeUse.body: The app is free, and so is the Google Gemini API key that powers photo analysis. Create a key in Google AI Studio without enabling billing and you never pay anything.

accuracy.title: Double-check the numbers
accuracy.body: The AI doesn't always get grams and calories exactly right. Keep an eye on the values and adjust them when needed.

lighting.title: Shoot in good light
lighting.body: The AI recognizes sharp, well-lit photos much better. Try to avoid blur and heavy shadows.

averaging.title: Think in averages
averaging.body: The app isn't built for precise measurements. It's for averaging your intake over a week or month, which gives a more accurate picture of your diet.

packaging.title: Photograph the packaging
packaging.body: Sometimes it helps to photograph the package (processed food, a burger, a can of cola or juice) so the AI can better understand what you are eating.

scale.title: Use a kitchen scale
scale.body: To help the AI estimate grams, place the plate on a scale and photograph it with the reading visible (remember to tare the plate's weight).

freeTiers.title: Some providers are free
freeTiers.body: Several AI providers give free access, at least in limited amounts (Gemini, OpenAI, OpenRouter). Tap “How to get an API key” in Settings to see what each one offers.

models.title: Pick a capable model
models.body: Some AI models perform better than others. Use OpenAI/gpt-4o or Google/gemini-3.5-flash for the best value for the price.

settings.resetConfirmMessage: This will reset your personal data and daily calorie goal. Your daily meal history and API keys will not be affected.
settings.deleteAllConfirmMessage: This will permanently delete everything: all your meals, personal data, settings, and API keys. This cannot be undone.

common.dailyCaloriesMinWarning: This is the minimum safe intake ({{min}} kcal). Consider a gentler pace.
common.disclaimer: AI makes mistakes. The same image can yield different values, and the app isn't designed to calculate precise grams or calories. If you're unsure of the results, correct them manually. This is not a medical application. Consult a doctor or registered dietitian before making changes to your diet.
